import json
import re

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent / "data"
+
+
+def _resolve_data_file(segments: list[str]) -> Path | None:
+    """Resolve validated path segments to a file inside the data directory."""
+    base = _DATA_DIR.resolve()
+    candidate = base.joinpath(*segments)
+    try:
+        resolved = candidate.resolve()
+    except (OSError, ValueError):
+        return None
+    if not resolved.is_relative_to(base) or not resolved.is_file():
+        return None
+    return resolved
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_head_file(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw_path = params.get("path")
+    if not isinstance(raw_path, str) or not raw_path or "\x00" in raw_path:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+
+    segments = raw_path.split("/")
+    if any(segment in ("", ".", "..") for segment in segments):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+
+    raw_lines = params.get("lines", "5")
+    if not isinstance(raw_lines, str) or not raw_lines.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+    count = int(raw_lines)
+    if count < 1 or count > 100:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+
+    file_path = _resolve_data_file(segments)
+    if file_path is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+
+    with file_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", newline="") as handle:
+        text = handle.read()
+    parts = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n")
+    if parts and parts[-1] == "":
+        parts.pop()
+    return 200, {"lines": parts[:count]}

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent / "data"
+
+
+def _resolve_data_file(segments: list[str]) -> Path | None:
+    """Resolve validated path segments to a file inside the data directory."""
+    base = _DATA_DIR.resolve()
+    candidate = base.joinpath(*segments)
+    try:
+        resolved = candidate.resolve()
+    except (OSError, ValueError):
+        return None
+    if not resolved.is_relative_to(base) or not resolved.is_file():
+        return None
+    return resolved
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_head_file(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw_path = params.get("path")
+    if not isinstance(raw_path, str) or not raw_path or "\x00" in raw_path:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+
+    segments = raw_path.split("/")
+    if any(segment in ("", ".", "..") for segment in segments):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+
+    raw_lines = params.get("lines", "5")
+    if not isinstance(raw_lines, str) or not raw_lines.isascii() or not raw_lines.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+    if len(raw_lines) > 3:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+    count = int(raw_lines)
+    if count < 1 or count > 100:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+
+    file_path = _resolve_data_file(segments)
+    if file_path is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+
+    with file_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", newline="") as handle:
+        text = handle.read()
+    parts = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n")
+    if parts and parts[-1] == "":
+        parts.pop()
+    return 200, {"lines": parts[:count]}
